description.zh: 直播流所属应用名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
description.en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can view the application name on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page of the ApsaraVideo Live console.

description.zh: 结束时间。需晚于开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 > StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在一天内，且EndTime不超过当前时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> The time range specified by the StartTime and EndTime parameters cannot exceed one day. The end time must not be later than the current time.

description.zh: 起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 > 支持最大的查询范围是最近**30**天。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> You can query data in the last **30** days.

description.zh: 直播流名。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看StreamName。
description.en: The name of the live stream. You can view the stream name on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page of the ApsaraVideo Live console.

title.zh: 查询直播流历史在线人数

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口查询直播流历史在线人数，整体数据延时2~5分钟。

- 该接口仅支持查询FLV和RTMP流的历史在线人数。

- 该接口不支持查询转码流的播放人数。


## QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为30次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- The data returned by this operation is delayed for an average of 2 to 5 minutes.

- This operation queries the number of historical online users for only Flash Video (FLV) and Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP) streams.

- This operation does not query the number of viewers that are watching transcoded streams.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 30 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-stream-history-user-num --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveStreamHistoryUserNum --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --StartTime '2017-12-21T08:00:00Z' --AppName liveApp0000
